verdict.rationale: Secret-scanning products can plausibly expose an HTTP API, and gitleaks.io describes team-level scanning of pull requests and commits, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only a CLI, a GitHub Action and a TOML config format, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs at all common paths returned 404. No machine-readable API spec is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
